caseName: Madsen v. Women's Health Center, Inc.
caseNameFull: Madsen Et Al. v. Women’s Health Center, Inc., Et Al.

opinions.text: Sup. Ct. Fla. Certiorari granted. Brief of petitioners is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Friday, March 4, 1994. Brief of respondents is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Friday, April 1, 1994. A reply brief, if any, is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or beforé 3 p.m., Friday, April 15, 1994. This Court’s Rule 29 does not apply.
